metadata.title: About the Studio | 7C Studio
metadata.description: Meet the people behind 7C Studio and discover our approach to honest wedding photography, thoughtful films and memories made to last.

hero.alt: A wedding couple sharing a joyful moment during their reception
hero.quote: A photograph is a return ticket to a moment otherwise gone.
hero.title: We Capture More Than Moments.
hero.description: From quiet glances to unforgettable celebrations, we document every emotion, connection, and detail that makes your wedding uniquely yours.

image.alt: A couple exchanging flower garlands during a traditional wedding ceremony

heading: It started with
one camera.
paragraphs: 7C Studio began with one camera and a simple belief: the moments that matter most are often the ones you cannot plan — a shared glance, a familiar laugh, the quiet before a celebration begins.
We pay attention to the people, the traditions, and the small details that make every celebration unique, creating photographs and films that hold the feeling of your day.

items.heading: Quietly, from the edges of the room
items.description: Two photographers and one filmmaker on most weddings. Available light wherever possible. No shot lists read off a phone, no group photographs that take an hour.

items.heading: The same hands, start to finish
items.description: The person who meets you photographs your wedding and edits your gallery. No outsourced teams, no unfamiliar faces on the day.

items.heading: A consistent, considered grade
items.description: One colour language across every frame, every film and every print, so your archive holds together decades from now.

items.heading: Made to be printed
items.description: Every commission ends in something physical: hand-bound albums and archival prints produced in our own studio.

heading: Light, colour and
the way a day feels.
paragraphs: We are photographers and filmmakers first. The work begins long before the first frame: reading a room, understanding a family, and deciding where the light will be in an hour.
Every wedding is edited by the same hands that photographed it, in a colour language we have built over years. Nothing is outsourced, and nothing is rushed.

items.heading: Story before setup
items.description: We follow the day as it happens rather than arranging it for the camera. Direction stays quiet, so the people in the frame stay themselves.

items.heading: A colour language of our own
items.description: Warm skin tones, deep shadows and restraint. One considered grade across photographs, films and print so the archive holds together.

items.heading: Finished by hand
items.description: From the first edit to the final album, every commission is finished in our own studio and made to be kept, not just posted.
